description:
Reminders for your recurring tasks: filters, plants, backups, car checks…
MainTask helps you never forget your recurring tasks: filter changes, watering plants, backups, car checks…

Set each task with its interval (every X days, weekly or monthly) and MainTask reminds you before it's due.

Features:

* Recurring tasks: fixed intervals, weekly or monthly
* One-shot tasks, with or without a target date
* Snooze a task, or skip an occurrence without leaving it overdue
* Checklists on any task: groceries, errands, things to bring…
* Photo attachment on a task, from your gallery or the camera
* Completion history for each task
* Month calendar view, category filter, search in titles and checklists
* "Today" filter: only what's overdue or due today, in one tap (also from the tile and the widget)
* Notifications right on time, even when the phone is asleep, and customizable (up to 14 days before, at the time you choose, per task if you want)
* Overdue tasks reminded again: every day, every 3 days or every week
* "Done" and "Snooze" buttons right inside notifications
* Scrollable home screen widget
* Quick Settings tile
* 5 color themes + dark mode
* Backup export / import (history and photos included)
* Available in English, French and German

Privacy-friendly: no ads, no trackers, no account. Everything stays on your device (Android backup is optional and off by default).
